subject: Logic
title: Hilbert's Hotel
description: A quick win: understand Hilbert's Hotel.

hook.text: A hotel with infinitely many rooms is fully booked. A new guest arrives. The manager smiles: no problem.

buildup.text: Move every guest from room n to room n+1. Room 1 is now free. Infinite occupancy, infinite vacancies—simultaneously.

discovery.text: Even if infinitely many new guests arrive, shift everyone to room 2n. All odd rooms are now free—infinitely many.

twist.text: Hilbert's thought experiment reveals that infinity doesn't behave like large numbers—it breaks normal intuitions.

climax.text: Adding to infinity changes nothing about its size. Infinity plus anything is still the same infinity.

punchline.text: Always room at the infinite inn.

quiz.question: What does Hilbert's Hotel demonstrate?
options: Infinity defies normal intuitions about size and capacity
